Definition: from G3448 and G4160; to fabricate the image of a bullock:--make a calf.
BiblicalUsage: Moschopoieo means to make a calf — in those days they made a calf, and offered sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Stephen's charge still lands: the calf was not made by accident, it was made on purpose, and men rejoice in what their own hands made.
